title: VelocityFPS
description: This modpack is built to maximize FPS, and improve performance.
body:
This is a FPS modpack including but not lemited to Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ModernFix, ImmediatelyFast. This modpack aims to create a high fps modpack for potato computers. On a cumputer with a CPU: 8x Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-8250U CPU @ 1.60GHz. On noraml none modded minecraft we got 15 fps. But using the VelocityFPS modpack we got upwards of 150 fps with 32 chunks and defalt settings. And on higher end sytems like 3070ti nividea card with intel core i9 with 32 gigs of ram, we got upwards of 700 fps.

*This modpack is on 1.26.1 a vary new version and bugs may be present.
